From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-13T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Draft annotated answers and evidence list (internal)

Team — draft attached. Major notes for product/security review before final:

1) Audit logs & retention: We state 7 years for tenant-level billing and 2 years for high-fidelity per-request traces by default; longer retention is available via Dedicated/Private with KMS and archive export. Need Marcus to confirm phrasing on archival mechanisms (S3/Cold storage) and retention controls.

2) Data residency: For Private deployments we can document customer-managed region and explicit region binding. For Hosted, we provide region-level routing but not guaranteed single-region tenancy unless on Dedicated. Elena asked explicitly for multi-region failover behavior — Laura, please prepare 1–2 bullet examples of routing policy.

3) Resilience/DR: Our DR runbook excerpt points to weekly DR drills, table-top exercises quarterly, and a full failover test annually for Dedicated customers. We should include a sanitized drill log as sample (manifest lists placeholder entries).

4) Model serving specifics: Clarify that KV cache is ephemeral per-instance and retained only for request TTL; any long-term caching for performance (prefix caching) is captured in the cache policy document. Marcus: short sentence needed on cache retention and redaction controls.

5) SOC 2 scope: We will explicitly call out that SOC 2 covers hosted API and core control plane; Dedicated can be included depending on contractual scope and evidence access. Legal will support cover letter language.

Attached: RFI_annotated_answers_v1.docx, evidence_manifest.csv

Please review and flag anything that is too technical for the customer or legally sensitive. I will incorporate edits and prepare the final PDF for submission.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Compliance Solutions
ben_carter@redwood.com

(Attachment stubs: RFI_annotated_answers_v1.docx; evidence_manifest.csv)

2) For SOC 2, confirm whether Dedicated customers receive a separate SOC 2 addendum or whether they rely on Redwood's consolidated audit artifacts.

We also require a signed cover letter confirming the scope of evidence provided and a representative contact for any follow-up. I attached our cover-letter template — please complete and return with your evidence bundle.

Subject: Re: Operational Controls Questionnaire - Redwood Inference (FINAL Submission)

Elena — attaching our finalized response packet per your template and the evidence manifest. Highlights:

- Data residency: Hosted API supports regional endpoints and customer routing policies; single-region tenancy is available on Dedicated or Private deployments and is documented in the Private deployment addendum. Hosted audit logs are exportable via support request for auditor review; Dedicated provides direct access to log exports under contractual terms.
- SOC 2 scope: Redwood's SOC 2 report covers the hosted control plane and core runtime; Dedicated/Private evidence access is handled via contractual attachments and, where applicable, a scoped SOC addendum.
- Retention: Default per-request traces (2 years) and billing artifacts (7 years); Dedicated/Private can be configured for longer retention and custom export frequency.
- DR runbook excerpt attached (sanitized): weekly smoke tests, quarterly table-top, annual full failover; sample drill entries included in the evidence manifest.

Attachments submitted: Redwood_RFI_annotated_final.pdf (annotated answers + control mapping), DR_runbook_excerpt.md (sanitized runbook extract), evidence_manifest.csv (list of sample artifacts and how to request full exports), completed_CrownHarbor_cover_letter.docx (signed by Vanessa Ortiz).

If you'd like a short walk-through of the packet we can schedule 30 mins next week — propose Oct 19 at 10:00am PT.

Best,
